items.t: Automatic transmission slips, shudders or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt unit
items.note: Owners report average costs of about $4,000-$4,300.

items.t: Rear suspension bracket and frame can rust through (recall)
items.note: The recall (10V-436) is free. Rust damage outside the recall repair is not covered.

items.t: Passenger air bag may not inflate correctly (recall)
items.note: Free passenger air bag replacement under recalls 01V-055 and 02V-213.

items.t: ABS can lengthen stopping distance (recall)
items.note: Free ABS control update under campaign 02I-002.

items.t: Rear lower link nut can loosen (recall)
items.note: Free bolt and nut replacement under recall 00V-058.

items.t: Engine wiring ground can break and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free engine harness repair under recall 98V-170.

items.t: Fuel pump port can develop pinholes and leak (recall)
items.note: Free cover or fuel pump replacement under recall 05V-466.

items.t: Paint and body rust problems
items.job: Rust and paint repair on one panel
items.note: Price varies widely by shop and damage.

items.t: Frame rusts through
items.note: Severe rust may make the repair cost more than the vehicle is worth.

items.t: Engine knocking or failure at high mileage
items.job: Replace engine with a used unit
items.note: Owners report averages of about $3,000-$4,500.

items.t: Drive belt squeals and wears out
Poor FM radio reception
items.job: Diagnose antenna and connections under warranty
items.note: Covered by the new-vehicle warranty.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free fuel pump module replacement under recalls 21V-215 and 23V-858.

items.t: Front frame welds may be missing (recall)
items.note: Free inspection, with repurchase or replacement if welds are missing, under recall 19V-784.

items.t: Hood can fly open while driving (recall)
items.note: Free striker repair or hood replacement under recall 21V-932.

items.t: Continental tires may have a sidewall defect (recall)
items.note: Free tire inspection and replacement under recall 21V-165.

items.t: Backup camera image delayed or missing (recall)
items.note: Free updates and harness replacement under recalls 20V-439, 20V-440 and 23V-431.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor fault can affect the air bag (recall)
items.note: Free sensor replacement under recalls 24V-064 and 26V-332.

items.t: Brake master cylinder can separate from the booster (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and repair under recall 23V-458.

items.t: Rear subframe can rust at the suspension mounts (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and reinforcement under recall 26V-365.

items.t: Steering gearbox ball joint can loosen (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and gearbox replacement under recall 24V-184.

items.t: Fuel filler neck tube can separate and leak (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and repair under recall 24V-900.

items.t: Rear subframe bolts may be loose (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and bolt replacement under recall 26V-424.

items.t: Engine may not restart after Auto Idle Stop
items.job: Replace starter and starter cut relays (after the dealer software update)
items.note: Honda first updates the engine software, then replaces the starter and relays and may adjust the valves. 2019-2022 models have a Honda warranty extension (10 years, unlimited miles) that covers this for free. Parts: aftermarket starter about $149, OEM 31200-5J2 about $241-$349. Labor: 0.9 hr flat rate for starter and relays in Honda bulletin 23-023; Honda tells owners the full extended-warranty repair takes about 3 hours. YourMechanic: about $1,051 total for a 2019-2020 starter job.

items.t: 9-speed automatic makes harsh or jerky upshifts
items.note: Honda bulletins 19-124 and 20-029 list a 0.2 hr flat rate for the TCM update and no parts. It is covered under Honda's normal warranty; outside warranty a dealer may also charge a diagnosis fee.

items.t: Engine won't crank after rain or snow and a hard freeze
items.job: Replace starter motor and both starter cut relays
items.note: Labor: 0.9 hr flat rate for Passport in Honda bulletin 23-023 (normal warranty applies). Parts: OEM starter 31200-5J2-A52 about $241 discounted to $349 list; the two starter cut relays (39794-T5A-J01) add a little and are not included.

items.t: Accessory running board lights flicker or stay off
items.job: Inspect harness and replace all four running board lights
items.note: Labor: Honda bulletin 20-022 lists 0.3 hr to inspect the harness and fuse, plus 0.6 hr to replace all four lights (0.9 hr total). Parts: four puddle lights (34761-TZ3-A02 left, 34261-TZ3-A02 right, two of each) at about $51.94 each discounted or $73.36 list. If only the 2A inline fuse or a connector is at fault, the bill is just the 0.3 hr inspection.
